title: bybit_1 demo is margin-starved: available 120 USD of ~122k equity, so every new bybit_1 entry is risk_refused (desk probe #2 refused 18:07Z)
note: OBSERVED 2026-10-27 ~18:10Z (manager, MEASURED): (1) desk mechanics probe #2 (DD-20261027T1803Z-scan-1h-1, BTCUSDT long, entry 80511 SL 80100 TP 80830.9) was accepted by intake and dispatched, then refused by RiskManager: 'risk_refused: sized_qty=0 with balance=122428.48 available_usd=0.00 total_account_usd=122436.53 direction=long market_type=linear — check daily-loss budget / liquidation buffer / max_borrow' (journalctl ict-trader-live 18:07:00Z). (2) /api/diag/broker_account_status: bybit_1 available_margin read_state venue_available, available_usd 120.23 (broker truth). With 11 open packages, initial margin consumes ~all equity. CONSEQUENCE: on the demo floor no NEW bybit_1 entry can size (desk, probes, every Stage-1 crypto leg) until positions close; the soak/probe mechanics are blocked by margin, not by code. OPEN QUESTIONS: per-symbol leverage on bybit_1 (likely low/1x vs risk_pct 0.0075 sizing at full notional); whether RiskManager should size against available margin and report it as a distinct refusal reason; 30d realized on bybit_1 -17.9k USD (bybit_wallet_truth). FIX OPTIONS (Tier 3, operator): raise bybit_1 leverage (venue setting) so notional fits margin; cap concurrent bybit_1 positions; or a per-account notional/margin budget in RiskManager. DETECTOR: broker_account_status bybit_1 available_usd below one hundredth of equity (a threshold, not a measurement), or risk_refused with available_usd=0.00. CLOSES WHEN: a demo entry sizes and fills on bybit_1 with >= 3 positions already open. [2026-10-27 22:35Z manager] OPERATOR DECISION (popup, verbatim): "Raise leverage on bybit_1 (Recommended)". MEASURED 22:25Z (/api/diag/bybit_raw_positions?account_id=bybit_1, wallet block): total_equity 122,310.77, total_margin_balance 39,125.07, total_position_im 40,006.24, total_available_balance -881.18; 5 open short positions (SOL, AVAX, ETH, XRP, ADA), all at leverage 3. ROOT CAUSE REFINED: most equity is non-USDT collateral (1 BTC ~80.8k, 50k USDC, 1 ETH) that the UTA does not count toward margin, so the margin balance is ~32% of equity, while RiskManager risk-sizes on balance 122k. FIX: config/accounts.yaml bybit_1 risk.leverage 3 -> 10 (PR claude/bybit1-leverage-10; Tier-3 hold). Leverage only lifts the margin cap (risk.py ~L1254); risk_pct 0.0075 unchanged. Expected: IM ~40k -> ~12k after the boot set-leverage, freeing ~28k. FOLLOW-UP (not fixed here): the collateral basis vs sizing basis mismatch. [2026-10-27 23:55Z manager] MERGED #20747 (40896b3ee). DEPLOYED: /api/diag/version 23:48:24Z trader_git_sha 08998b899 (contains 40896b3ee; config/accounts.yaml:397 leverage 10), restart_pending false. OBSERVED 23:49:25Z /api/diag/bybit_raw_positions?account_id=bybit_1: all 5 open positions at leverage 10 (BTCUSDT Buy, AVAX/SOL/ADA/ETH Sell); wallet total_position_im 32,168.92, total_margin_balance 38,473.12, total_available_balance +6,304.20 (was -881.18 at 22:25Z). CLOSING CONDITION MET: journal trade 6757 ict_scalp_5m BTCUSDT long, entry 80977.0, SL 80738.82, status open, created 23:46:05Z on bybit_1 with 4 positions already open; the same leg was rejected at 14:30Z (trade 6748) when margin was 0. FOLLOW-UPS (not fixed here, filed as notes): (1) a tight-stop leg (0.29% stop) at 0.75% risk now takes ~34k notional (IM 23.4k at 10x), which consumed most of the freed margin in one entry; available is back to ~.3k, so starvation can recur when several such legs fire; (2) RiskManager sizes on balance ~122k while the UTA margin balance is ~38k (non-USDT collateral not counted) -- the sizing-basis vs collateral-basis mismatch remains.
